name: Excel Diagnostics
description: Read-only search of Excel diagnostics log bundles kept in a folder on the host.

bundlesDir.description: Absolute path of the folder that holds the bundles (zips or unzipped folders). Default: <OpenClaw state folder>/excel-diagnostics/bundles. Takes effect on gateway restart.

timeoutSeconds.description: Longest one tool call may take. Default 120. Takes effect on gateway restart.
